tools.name: search_patents
tools.description: Search public patent records by keywords, claim language, CPC class, assignee, inventor, or grant date. Every number in the result was returned by USPTO or EPO. Not legal advice.

tools.name: get_patent
tools.description: Fetch one patent's title, abstract, claims, status, family, and citations from USPTO and, when configured, EPO. Missing text is omitted rather than filled in. Not legal advice.

tools.name: find_patent_citations
tools.description: List documents cited by a patent and documents that cite it, using USPTO grant references, USPTO office-action citations, and EPO citation search. This is not the full PatentsView citation graph, which is paused. Not legal advice.

tools.name: search_prior_art
tools.description: Turn an idea description into a public-patent search and return the closest records the offices actually returned, with Google Patents links. Ranking counts overlapping words. It is not a patentability opinion. Not legal advice.
